|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 7.3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-02-Admiral_Pellaeon.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-admiralpellaeon-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-02-Admiral_Pellaeon-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), Dark Side p. 2: “[Pilot] 2. May be revealed from hand to ▲ Justifier and deploy both simultaneously (for -1 Force each). Opponent’s passengers here are forfeit = 0. Once per game, if aboard Justifier, may lose 1 Force to move away from battle as a ‘react’ (at hyperspeed +2).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 3). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spells “revealed” as “reveled”, reads “lose one force” for “lose 1 Force”, drops the comma after “if aboard Justifier” and the quotation marks around “react” (it also writes the pilot icon and ▲ out in words): “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May be reveled from hand to take Justifier into hand from reserve deck; reshuffle and deploy both simultaneously (for -1 force each). Opponent's passengers here are forfeit = 0. Once per game, if aboard Justifier may lose one force to move away from battle as a react (at hyperspeed +2).”.<ref name="cl-1273_2-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of 14 March and 16 May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
|hatnote=For the later errata text, see [[Admiral Pellaeon (Errata)]].
